{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''shuttle''' was used by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[trade officer]] [[Gode Takrab]]. It was similar in shape to a big, dusty yellow [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]]<ref name="Wizard">{{WizCite|story=Peril on Naboo|book=Secrets of Naboo}}</ref> of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Takrab was ordered to fly to the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], along with his droid [[TC-11]], for an important mission. Two security [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s were assigned to protect the shuttle. [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] then assigned an additional squad, commanded by [[RK-7]], to protect the shuttle, because Takrab's mission was very important. Besides, should Takrab be killed in the battle, Gunray intended to use the shuttle as an escape way.<ref name="Wizard" />
